source: Hand-entered rows; every value carries its own source. Geometry values are model choices guided by the cited papers and are approximate.

distance.source: Adopted 400 pc: Menten et al. 2007, A&A 474, 515 (414 ± 7 pc, VLBA parallax); Kounkel et al. 2017, ApJ 834, 142 (388 ± 5 pc); Großschedl et al. 2018, A&A 619, A106 (Gaia DR2, ~400 pc)

field.source: Build choice: a gnomonic square centred on θ¹ Ori C that stays inside the Stellarium image footprint; emission and dust fade to 0 between edgeFade·halfWidth and the edge (model choice)

photometry.totalSource: OpenNGC NGC1976 V = 4.0, integrated inside 30' of θ¹ Ori C (M43 excluded)
photometry.coreSource: Approximate peak V surface brightness of the Huygens region (16-17 mag/arcsec², e.g. O'Dell 2001, ARA&A 39, 99), measured as the brightest 0.5' radius disk

photo.cameraSource: Model choice: linear photo RGB of one unit of Hα+[NII] (656/658 nm, pink-red), [OIII]+Hβ (501/486 nm, teal) and scattered starlight (blue-white) for a typical one-shot-colour astro camera; used to unmix the Stellarium photo

coreMix.source: Luminance (V-weighted) shares of the Huygens region where the photo is clipped: observed I(5007)/I(Hβ) ≈ 3.4, I(4959) ≈ 5007/3, Hα/Hβ ≈ 3.5, [NII] 6584/Hα ≈ 0.25 (Esteban et al. 2004, MNRAS 355, 229; O'Dell 2001) weighted by V(λ) (CIE 1931), with ~13% scattered Trapezium light; the [OIII]-dominated core reads teal-white

bowl.source: Main ionization front ~0.2 pc behind θ¹ Ori C, concave towards Earth: Wen & O'Dell 1995, ApJ 438, 784; O'Dell 2001, ARA&A 39, 99

bar.source: Orion Bar: the ionization front seen edge-on ~2' (0.23 pc) SE of θ¹ Ori C, running NE-SW (PA ~60°) for ~10' (half-length ~1.2 pc): O'Dell 2001; Wen & O'Dell 1995. Rise, width and length of the escarpment are model choices

sheet.source: Emitting layer near θ¹ Ori C: Wen & O'Dell 1995 (ApJ 438, 784) give ~0.1 pc for the ionized layer; with n_e ~1-2e4 cm⁻³ there (O'Dell 2001) its emission measure (~1e7 cm⁻⁶ pc) fits in a few 0.01 pc, so 0.03 pc is adopted at the core (model choice that also shortens the extrusion of the 2.5D model seen from inside), thickening outwards. Noise amplitudes and the lateral warp (in half-thicknesses, near the nebula only) are model choices

m43.source: M43 as an H II sphere ionized by NU Ori (Simón-Díaz et al. 2011, A&A 530, A57); ~10' across at 400 pc

veil.source: Orion's Veil: a neutral foreground layer ~1-3 pc in front of θ¹ Ori C with A_V ~ 1-2 mag (O'Dell 2001; Abel et al. 2019, ApJ 881, 130); A_V up to ~4-5 mag in the Dark Bay (O'Dell & Yusef-Zadeh 2000, AJ 120, 382), hence maxTau 4.5. The 0.3 pc minimum gap to the emission is a model choice

darkBay.source: The Dark Bay NE of the Trapezium is extinction in the Veil (A_V up to ~4-5), not missing gas: the radio continuum shows the ionized gas continuing smoothly behind it (O'Dell & Yusef-Zadeh 2000, AJ 120, 382). Inside radiusArcmin and the PA window the light short of its azimuthal envelope at the same radius is put in the Veil (τ = ln(envelope / L)), so the view from Earth is unchanged and the bowl behind the Veil is not dark there. Window and percentile are model choices

omc.source: OMC-1 and the Orion A molecular cloud behind the ionization front (opaque in V): O'Dell 2001

extinctionRatios.source: A_λ/A_V for R_V ≈ 5.5 (Orion's flat extinction law): Cardelli et al. 1989, ApJ 345, 245, at 656, 500 and ~470 nm
